name: @ci/capacitor-app-lock
description: Capacitor plugin for the biometric app lock: a native lock state (locked on cold start and after a grace period in the background), the OS unlock prompt with passcode fallback (BiometricPrompt with BIOMETRIC_STRONG|DEVICE_CREDENTIAL on Android, LAContext .deviceOwnerAuthentication on iOS), a native overlay drawn above the WebView while locked, and screen blanking in the task switcher (FLAG_SECURE on Android, a blur on iOS). The lock is a presentation gate: sync continues behind it and the database key is never biometric-gated. Ships both native implementations, like @ci/capacitor-local-hub.
